title: Print preview fails on Linux (every form)
now: Print preview failed: the window handle kind is not supported.
why: The in-app preview embeds a web view (wry). On Linux wry only accepts an Xlib window handle, but GPUI gives XCB on X11 (and Wayland on Wayland). The open-in-browser fallback only runs if the window itself can't open, so it never runs here. macOS and Windows are fine.

options.name: Open in browser on Linux
options.detail: Use the existing file + open-in-browser path on Linux. One cfg change; prints from the browser.

options.name: Try in-app, then fall back
options.detail: Keep the in-app window; if the web view fails, close it and open the browser instead.

options.name: GTK-hosted window
options.detail: Host the preview in a GTK window wry accepts. Most work; keeps printing in-app.
